reading: The report describes a growing series of suspected attacks on defence sites in Europe.
Germany has blamed Russia for an attack involving drones at Leipzig airport.
The airport is used to transport military supplies for Ukraine.
Other countries have reported suspicious fires at defence facilities.
Some governments have blamed Russia, while investigations elsewhere are still continuing.
Some of the fires may eventually be found to have been accidental.
Russia is the main suspect in the report.
